description.value:
You learn to harness divine energy to heal your allies or harm your foes. You have a pool of d6s equal to your wizard level. If you use a feature that uses these dice, the number of dice you expend can be no larger than half your wizard level (rounded down). You regain all expended dice when you finish a Long Rest.

Heal. As an Action, expend a number of d6s from your pool and roll them. Choose creatures within 30 feet of you that you can see. Each target is healed by an amount of equal to the total of the roll.

Harm. As an Action, expend a number of d6s from your pool and roll them. Choose creatures within 30 feet of you that you can see. Each target has to make a Charisma Saving Throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it takes an amount of damage of a type you choose when you gain this feature (cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or radiant) equal to the total of the roll. On a success, it takes half as much damage. If the target is an undead or a fiend, it has Disadvantage on the Saving Throw, and the feature deals maximum damage to it.
